# HAI7 (Heuristic Artificial Intelligence)

> HAI7 builds and deploys enterprise-grade AI agents, workflow automations, and intelligent applications with rapid 7-day POC delivery.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous AI Agents**: Goal-driven agents that reason, use tools, and take action across enterprise systems.
- **Automation Platforms**: Intelligent automation eliminating manual bottlenecks across workflows, document processing, and routing.
- **Enterprise AI Solutions**: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), private knowledge bases, and decision engines with role-based security.
- **Custom AI Applications**: Production-ready software built on modern LLM-native architectures.

## The 7-Day Promise
Whenever feasible, HAI7 scopes, builds, and delivers a production-ready proof of concept within 7 calendar days.

## Products
- **ECMS (Enterprise Content Management System)**: Governed content intelligence, document classification, and contract management.
- **ResolveIQ**: AI-powered issue resolution and citizen support platform.
- **Northline**: Financial and operations tracking intelligence.
